title: Casper and the Veil
author: Ulyana Iversen
blurb: Noor Yarrow, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
